basics.name: Jack Stehn
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer who builds production systems at the intersection of data and software. I bring strong engineering practices (testing, modular design, clean code) to APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure, and have led cross-functional technical initiatives.

work.name: Innovare
highlights: **System Reliability:** Owned the stability and scalability of production data systems serving enterprise customers, treating analytics infrastructure as a software product with uptime, correctness, and performance requirements.
**Architecture Consulting:** Helped design a Medallion architecture on BigQuery with clear layer contracts from ingestion to serving.
**Modern Toolchain Advocacy:** Proposed replacing ad-hoc scripts with a tested, version-controlled stack: Terraform, dlt, dbt, Dagster, Cube.js.
**Workflow Automation:** Designed and built automated workflows that replaced manual, error-prone delivery processes — reducing turnaround time and eliminating recurring operational toil.

work.name: Caliber Public Schools
work.position: Data Scientist (Lead: Data Systems, Platform Engineering) - Ed Pioneers Fellow
highlights: **Platform Architecture:** Architected and built a scalable data platform on GCP, orchestrating automated pipelines using Dagster, dbt, and dlt with comprehensive test coverage.

**API Integration & Interoperability:** Solved complex system interoperability challenges by designing integrations between Schoolmint and PowerSchool. Reverse-engineered undocumented APIs to create a unified data model.
**Engineering Maturity (ROI):** Automated data quality checks, cutting manual consistency work from months a year to seconds.
**Data Democratization:** Updated the data security policy and built trainings so non-technical staff could access real-time metrics.

work.name: SetSail
highlights: **Pipeline Architecture (AWS):** Led an AWS data infrastructure overhaul (S3, Athena, EMR), cutting processing latency 75% at multi-TB scale.
**Engineering Best Practices:** Championed CI/CD (GitHub Actions), unit testing (pytest), and Agile within the data science team.
**Scalable Data Modeling:** Architected scalable Star Schema data models and optimized ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data readiness for LLM integration.
**Business Impact:** Contributed to product enhancements that achieved 33% faster ramp times, 16% higher revenue, and 15x customer ROI.
**Cross-Functional Leadership:** Worked with Engineering, Product, and Support to spec a large-scale infrastructure restructuring.
**Technical Consulting:** Diagnosed data discrepancies for enterprise customers and proposed architectural fixes.

work.name: Los Medanos College
highlights: **Full Stack Development:** Built a web app (Python, JavaScript, PHP, PostgreSQL) to guide students' program selection.
**Data Acquisition:** Built a database of 500+ university programs via web scraping (Beautiful Soup) and rigorous data cleaning.
**UX/UI:** Created an intuitive management dashboard for non-technical staff.
**Stakeholder Consulting:** Consulted with college stakeholders (district, counselors) to define user needs.
